summary: Modal for Startups grants a one-time award of free GPU/platform credits ('thousands' per the program page, not itemized) plus engineering/GTM support and a founder community. Eligibility: new Modal customers; Seed–Series A tier requires VC funding from Modal's partner network or >$1M raised from any fund; a Scaling/Series B+ tier exists for >$30M raised / post-Series B with a partner-network VC. A payment method is required; credits are a one-time grant per tier and cannot pay plan fees or endpoint charges. Create a Modal workspace before applying; the form requires its name, an email tied to it, and proof of funding.
claim_steps: Create a Modal account and organization workspace first (new Modal customers only).
Apply at modal.com/startups with the workspace name, an email tied to that workspace, and proof of funding.
Seed–Series A: VC funding from Modal's partner network, or >$1M raised from any fund.
On acceptance, the one-time credit grant lands on your account; add a payment method as required.

social_proof.title: Modal for Startups
social_proof.text: Apply to get free credits, technical support, and join a growing community. Unlock thousands of free GPU credits to supercharge your startup. Credits are a one-time grant and you may not reapply once you have received credits in a given tier.

social_proof.title: Modal startup application — workspace prerequisite

social_proof.title: Modal startup application — credit exclusions
social_proof.text: Please note, credits cannot be applied towards plan fees or endpoint charges.
